threads.body: [General] Register JDK 26 base images before advancing this value. `configureImage` currently accepts only 8/11/17/21/25 for HotSpot Linux/Windows and OpenJ9 (lines 302–331), so task creation reaches `26` and throws `GradleException` while configuring this project. Add pinned JDK 26 mappings in all three branches, or keep this at 25 until those images are available.
